run_f_gold: run f_gold to replace all AB occurrences with C in a character list in-place
test_f_gold: test f_gold against candidate f_filled using the provided parameter sets and compare results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace AB with C using a more efficient two-pointer approach
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like consecutive AB pairs or empty character lists
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which replaces AB substrings with C in a mutable character list without extra space
